subject: Request: Priority tether for Syndicate Financial activation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Syndicate - ask to prioritize tenant-isolation hook for activation

Monica / Marissa —

Quick context: Syndicate Financial (SYN-4872) signoff is in flight. They want a hard isolation gating (per-tenant runtime hook) to guarantee a soft SLA boundary for the first 90 days of production. Procurement flagged it as an activation blocker for their security committee.

What we're asking: can Eng ship a lightweight tenant-isolation toggle (routing policy + tenant affinity) that:
- gives Syndicate a stable model variant routing (p99 latency target) for first 90 days
- exposes a boolean flag we can flip per-customer from Console or API
- includes a short-term telemetry tag (syndicate.activation) for tracing and cost attribution

Why this matters: Syndicate has committed to a multi-year contract if we can meet this activation condition. If we can't, we risk losing the expand motion (they told us they won’t sign until the committee sees isolation controls).

Attachments: I attached the latest SOW and the activation matrix Syndicate sent.

Asks: Ben — can you pair with Product/Eng on feasibility and a proposed cut-down timeline? Monica — can you help escalate to product if we need a lane? Marissa — please confirm CS/MAM operations requirements (warm-up, cache seeding).

Thanks,

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Syndicate - ask to prioritize tenant-isolation hook for activation

Thanks Ben — pulling product/eng in. Aditya, high level question: is a console-toggle + routing policy feasible as a scoped work item (1–2 sprints) if we surface it as an EAP feature behind a flag? If not, what are the minimum must-haves we need to get Syndicate past their committee?

Important constraints from Syndicate (per procurement call):
- No shared KV with other customers for first 90 days (they want clear RTV for cache/kv)
- Traceability: every request must include a tenant token that maps to an audit log row
- Cost attribution: they need per-tenant cost breakdown for first invoice cycle

If we can give them a short-term path (toggle + telemetry + explicit routing), we can accept a slightly higher unit cost for the pilot and put in a roadmap promise for a hardened isolation feature later.

Ben — please confirm Syndicate will accept an EAP flag + additional invoice line item for isolated pool ops. If they want full tenant VPC/gated infra, that’s longer lead time and will need infra planning.

Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Strategic Accounts (Sales Ops)
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Syndicate - ask to prioritize tenant-isolation hook for activation

Monica / Ben —

Quick technical read: a minimal "priority tether" can be implemented without full infra changes if we accept some tradeoffs. Proposed approach (scoped, 2-week spike + 2-sprint delivery):

Spike (2 weeks):
- Add per-tenant routing tag to request context and ensure runtime routing honors the tag (no model changes).
- Add TTL’ed affinity slot that pins requests to a preferred pool variant for p99 stability.
- Surface a Console toggle to mark tenant as "priority-tethered" (admin only).
- Add lightweight audit rows for tenant token mapping (write to existing audit pipeline).

Delivery (2 sprints):
- Implement toggle and routing enrichment.
- Add telemetry (syndicate.activation tag) + cost-metering tag.
- Provide simple runbook for warm-up & cache seeding; CS can request manual pool pre-warm for activation day.

Constraints / caveats:
- This is not equivalent to tenant-level VPC isolation; a noisy neighbor could still affect cold-start resources in extreme cases.
- We will need telemetry retention adjustments to surface per-tenant cost for invoice (likely a 30-day window expansion).
- Requires a small console change and a runtime feature flag; patch should be low risk but we need product signoff to allocate sprint capacity.

Deliverables I need from Sales/CS to scope properly:
1) Exact list of behaviors the security committee requires as acceptance criteria (one-pager).
2) CdA on whether Syndicate accepts EAP + higher pilot cost for the first 90 days.
3) A designated Syndicate kickoff contact to coordinate cache seeding windows.

If we get the one-pager and confirmation, I can propose a concrete timeline and a JIRA epic.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@syndicate.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wu <emily.wu@syndicate.com>, procurement@syndicate.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Syndicate - ask to prioritize tenant-isolation hook for activation

Thanks Ben / Monica / Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear proposal. To confirm Syndicate's position:

1) The security committee will accept an EAP-level isolation toggle for a 90-day pilot provided:
   - We receive an explicit audit token mapping exported daily to our secure S3 (we can sign an NDA).
   - There is a documented runbook for cache seeding & an agreed warm-up window (we'll share times).
   - We accept an activation surcharge for the dedicated affinity slot for the pilot period.

2) If Redwood can get the spike plan into a JIRA within 5 business days and provide a demo to the security committee the following week, Syndicate will move forward with signature.

We're attaching a short acceptance checklist (see below). Ben — procurement@syndicate.com is on the thread for contract redlines.

— Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Production, Syndicate Financial
treynolds@syndicate.com
